# ERDDAP Dataset Monitor

Monitor the availability and update status of selected datasets hosted on the CoastWatch West Coast Node ERDDAP server. Filter by satellite data product, status, or dataset name.

[Explore all ERDDAP dataset statuses](https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/outOfDateDatasets.html){.cw-monitor-link target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}

:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import html
import pandas as pd
import yaml

from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote
from urllib.request import urlopen
from io import BytesIO

# -------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD EDITABLE DATASET WATCHLIST
# -------------------------------------------------------

watchlist = yaml.safe_load(
    Path("content/dataset_monitor.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
) or {}

watch = pd.DataFrame(watchlist.get("datasets", []))

for col in ("datasetID", "label", "category"):
    if col not in watch:
        watch[col] = ""

    watch[col] = (
        watch[col]
        .fillna("")
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
    )

watch = (
    watch.loc[watch["datasetID"] != ""]
    .drop_duplicates("datasetID")
    .copy()
)

watch.loc[watch["label"] == "", "label"] = watch["datasetID"]
watch.loc[watch["category"] == "", "category"] = "Other"


# -------------------------------------------------------
# RETRIEVE LIVE ERDDAP STATUS AT BUILD TIME
# -------------------------------------------------------

status_url = (
    "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/"
    "outOfDateDatasets.csv"
)

fetch_error = None

try:
    with urlopen(status_url, timeout=30) as response:
        status = pd.read_csv(BytesIO(response.read()))

    status.columns = status.columns.str.strip()

    if "datasetID" not in status or "outOfDate" not in status:
        raise ValueError(
            "ERDDAP response lacks required status columns"
        )

    status["datasetID"] = (
        status["datasetID"]
        .fillna("")
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
    )

    status = status.drop_duplicates("datasetID")

    df = watch.merge(
        status,
        on="datasetID",
        how="left"
    )

except Exception as exc:
    # Do not treat unavailable ERDDAP data as healthy.
    fetch_error = str(exc)

    df = watch.copy()
    df["outOfDate"] = float("nan")
    df["maxTime"] = pd.NA


# -------------------------------------------------------
# CLASSIFY STATUS
# -------------------------------------------------------

scores = pd.to_numeric(
    df["outOfDate"],
    errors="coerce"
)


def classify(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return "Not Flagged"

    if value < 1:
        return "OK"

    if value < 2:
        return "Delayed"

    return "Outdated"


df["status"] = scores.apply(classify)

priority = {
    "Outdated": 0,
    "Delayed": 1,
    "OK": 2,
    "Not Flagged": 3
}

df["priority"] = df["status"].map(priority)

df = df.sort_values(
    ["priority", "category", "label"],
    kind="stable"
)


# -------------------------------------------------------
# HTML HELPERS AND COUNTS
# -------------------------------------------------------

def esc(value):
    return html.escape(str(value), quote=True)


counts = df["status"].value_counts()


# -------------------------------------------------------
# STATUS OVERVIEW
# -------------------------------------------------------

print('<div class="cw-monitor-summary">')

print("""
<div class="cw-monitor-summary-head">
  <div>
    <span class="cw-monitor-eyebrow">
      MONITORING OVERVIEW
    </span>
    <h2>Dataset update status</h2>
  </div>
""")

print(
    '<span class="cw-monitor-total">'
    f'{len(df)} monitored datasets'
    '</span></div>'
)

print('<div class="cw-monitor-stats">')

for key, label, css in [
    ("Outdated", "Outdated", "outdated"),
    ("Delayed", "Delayed", "delayed"),
    ("OK", "OK", "ok"),
    ("Not Flagged", "Not Flagged", "unflagged"),
]:
    count = int(counts.get(key, 0))

    print(f"""
    <div class="cw-monitor-stat {css}">
      <strong>{count}</strong>
      <span>{label}</span>
    </div>
    """)

print("</div>")

if fetch_error:
    print("""
    <p class="cw-monitor-error" role="alert">
      ERDDAP status information could not be retrieved
      during this build. Dataset statuses are unavailable
      and have not been verified as current.
    </p>
    """)


# -------------------------------------------------------
# FILTER CONTROLS
# -------------------------------------------------------

print("""
<div class="cw-monitor-controls">

  <div>
    <label for="monitorSearch">Search datasets</label>
    <input
      id="monitorSearch"
      type="search"
      placeholder="Search dataset name or ID..."
    >
  </div>

  <div>
    <label for="categoryFilter">
      Satellite data product
    </label>
    <select id="categoryFilter">
      <option value="all">All products</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <div>
    <label for="statusFilter">Status</label>
    <select id="statusFilter">
      <option value="all">All statuses</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <button id="monitorReset" type="button">
    Reset filters
  </button>

</div>

<div class="cw-monitor-legend">
  <span>
    <b>Out-of-date score:</b>
    &lt;1 OK · 1–&lt;2 Delayed · ≥2 Outdated
  </span>
  <span>
    Not Flagged = no score in the ERDDAP status table
  </span>
</div>

</div>

<div class="cw-monitor-results">

  <div class="cw-monitor-results-head">
    <h2>Monitored datasets</h2>
    <span id="monitorCount" aria-live="polite"></span>
  </div>

  <div id="monitorGrid" class="cw-monitor-grid">
""")


# -------------------------------------------------------
# BUILD DATASET CARDS
# -------------------------------------------------------

for _, row in df.iterrows():

    dataset_id = str(row["datasetID"])

    url = (
        "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/info/"
        + quote(dataset_id, safe="")
        + "/index.html"
    )

    label = esc(row["label"])
    category = esc(row["category"])
    status_text = str(row["status"])

    score = pd.to_numeric(
        pd.Series([row["outOfDate"]]),
        errors="coerce"
    ).iloc[0]

    score_text = (
        f"{score:.2f}"
        if pd.notna(score)
        else "Not listed"
    )

    latest = row.get("maxTime")

    latest_text = (
        esc(latest)
        if pd.notna(latest) and str(latest).strip()
        else "Not listed"
    )

    search_text = esc(
        (str(row["label"]) + " " + dataset_id).lower()
    )

    status_class = status_text.lower().replace(" ", "-")

    print(f"""
    <article
      class="cw-monitor-item {status_class}"
      data-category="{category}"
      data-status="{esc(status_text)}"
      data-search="{search_text}"
    >

      <div class="cw-monitor-item-body">

        <h3>
          <a
            href="{esc(url)}"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
          >
            {label}
          </a>
        </h3>

        <p class="cw-monitor-id">
          Dataset ID:
          <code>{esc(dataset_id)}</code>
        </p>

        <div class="cw-monitor-meta">
          <span>
            <b>Out-of-date score:</b>
            {score_text}
          </span>

          <span>
            <b>Latest available data:</b>
            {latest_text}
          </span>
        </div>

      </div>

      <div class="cw-monitor-tags">
        <span class="cw-monitor-category">
          {category}
        </span>

        <span class="cw-monitor-badge">
          {esc(status_text)}
        </span>
      </div>

    </article>
    """)


print("""
  </div>

  <p id="monitorEmpty" class="cw-monitor-empty" hidden>
    No datasets match the current filters.
  </p>

</div>
""")
```

<!-- INTERACTIVE FILTERING -->

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {

  function init() {

    const grid = document.getElementById("monitorGrid");
    if (!grid) return;

    const rows = [
      ...grid.querySelectorAll(".cw-monitor-item")
    ];

    const category = document.getElementById("categoryFilter");
    const status = document.getElementById("statusFilter");
    const search = document.getElementById("monitorSearch");
    const count = document.getElementById("monitorCount");
    const empty = document.getElementById("monitorEmpty");
    const reset = document.getElementById("monitorReset");

    // Populate category options from dataset metadata.
    const categories = [
      ...new Set(rows.map(row => row.dataset.category))
    ].sort();

    categories.forEach(value => {
      category.add(new Option(value, value));
    });

    // Populate status options.
    ["Outdated", "Delayed", "OK", "Not Flagged"].forEach(value => {
      if (rows.some(row => row.dataset.status === value)) {
        status.add(new Option(value, value));
      }
    });

    function update() {

      const term = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      let visible = 0;

      rows.forEach(row => {

        const categoryMatch =
          category.value === "all" ||
          row.dataset.category === category.value;

        const statusMatch =
          status.value === "all" ||
          row.dataset.status === status.value;

        const searchMatch =
          !term || row.dataset.search.includes(term);

        const show =
          categoryMatch &&
          statusMatch &&
          searchMatch;

        row.hidden = !show;

        if (show) visible++;
      });

      count.textContent =
        `${visible} of ${rows.length} datasets shown`;

      empty.hidden = visible !== 0;
    }

    category.addEventListener("change", update);
    status.addEventListener("change", update);
    search.addEventListener("input", update);

    reset.addEventListener("click", () => {
      category.value = "all";
      status.value = "all";
      search.value = "";
      update();
    });

    update();
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }

})();
</script>
```
